fields.what_it_is: CD Horizon™ ModuLex™ 5.5 Spinal System for pedicle trajectory surgical technique. It is a modular spinal system with screw shanks (ATS, cortical, Osteogrip™, Titan nanoLOCK™), multi-axial screw heads, rods, set screws, and a modular distraction system. Instruments include shank drivers, depth stop sleeves, shank sleeves, decortication tool, head turner, provisional driver, set screw break off driver, rod template, rod holder, swizzle stick, countertorque, distractor, locking head inserter, and assembly components.
fields.sizing_specs: The system includes screw shanks in various diameters and lengths, with a modular distraction system offering two lengths: short legs accommodate blades up to 8 cm, long legs for blades longer than 8 cm. Screw shank diameters of 4.5mm or larger are compatible with CD Horizon™ modular heads. No explicit dimensions table provided.
fields.indications: Posterior spinal fixation procedures, including interbody fusion (e.g., TLIF, OLIF, DLIF, ALIF), decompression, discectomy, and spondylolisthesis reduction. Intended for use with bone graft to facilitate fusion.
fields.contraindications: Not for bicortical fixation. No other explicit contraindications stated.
fields.compatible_with: METRx™ II system, MAST™ Quadrant system, general instrument retractors, IPC™ Powerease™ system, Quick Connect Handle (G900000), StealthStation™ system, O-arm™ system, Midas Rex™ burr, NIM™ pedicle probe, CD Horizon™ modular spinal system heads and Osteogrip™ shanks, navigated posterior disc prep instruments, Medtronic bone graft options (e.g., Grafton™ Matrix Strips, Grafton™ DBF, Grafton™ Matrix, Magnifuse™ Bone Graft).
fields.use_notes: Patient placed prone. Use fluoroscopy or navigation for imaging (AP and lateral views). Skin incision lateral to pedicle (~1cm). Pedicle preparation with pilot hole, tapping optional. Screw shank placement: avoid over-advancement, ensure two threads visible outside bone. Head attachment via 4-step process (Attach, Confirm, Squeeze, Release) using locking head inserter. Distraction options: anatomy-based (spinous process or lamina) or screw shank-based (lassos, hooks, eyelets). Rod placement with rod holder. Set screw instrumentation with swizzle stick or provisional driver, final tightening with break off driver. Optional bone reaming for decortication. Additional bone grafting recommended. Implant explantation with obturator. Navigated workflow requires StealthStation™, O-arm™, instrument verification, reference frame placement, and image acquisition.
fields.also_known_as: ModuLex Surgical Technique 1, CD Horizon™ ModuLex™ 5.5 spinal system
